sourceData.readingMnemonic: If an old flower (or person) is <kanji>suffering</kanji>, give them a <reading>coo</reading>kie (<ja>く</ja>).
sourceData.meaningInfo: Old things go through a lot of suffering because their bodies are breaking down. Flowers are no different from you and me.
sourceData.readingInfo: No one can resist a good cookie. It will ease your suffering, or at least distract you for a little bit.
